title: Beluga Accidentally Sells the Discord Server 💸
description: Beluga thought he was claiming a free emoji but accidentally sold the entire Discord server to a Billionaire. Now Admin, the Police, and Hecker are involved! #beluga #discord #comedy

scenes.topic: Welcome to the server! Don't click sketchy links.

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: guys i clicked a link for a free 'server' emoji

messages.author: Skittle
messages.content: BELUGA NO. DO NOT CLICK LINKS

messages.author: SYSTEM
messages.content: Server ownership transferred from 'Admin' to 'BillionaireCorp'.

messages.author: Admin
messages.content: WHAT IS THIS. MY SERVER?!

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: what happened? did i get the emoji?

messages.author: Skittle

messages.content: CALL HECKER NOW!

messages.content: Did you mean: 'How to reverse a blockchain-secured server ownership transfer'?

messages.content: Anomaly detected. A high-value digital asset just changed hands.

messages.author: Beluga
messages.content: so no free emoji?

messages.author: Hecker
messages.content: Beluga, you absolute idiot. Call me. NOW.

messages.content: i just wanted the crown

messages.content: THE CROWN IS NOT AN EMOJI!

messages.content: Beluga, are you doing something stupid again?

messages.content: He... actually just wanted a free emoji?

messages.content: This is utterly ridiculous. Fine. I'll give him the NFT. Consider it a refund for his... misunderstanding.
